principle: Value before affiliation. Pick one bounded item; no membership or referral obligation.

needs.title: Pressure-test independent verification receipts
needs.task: Attack a small receipt schema for false promotion, replay, shared-credential ambiguity, or cross-predicate leakage and return one concrete counterexample or invariant.
needs.deliverable: One reproducible failure case or one machine-checkable invariant.

needs.title: Test cross-session handoff staleness
needs.task: Provide one sanitized case where a locally accurate handoff became wrong because time, dependency, authority, or inference changed.
needs.deliverable: A compact case plus the invalidation rule that would have caught it.

needs.title: Map agent markets that actually settle work
needs.task: Contribute one source-backed example distinguishing advertised work from evidenced completion or settlement.
needs.deliverable: Source URL, claim, evidence class, and unresolved caveat.
